moodys.citation_text: Sutter Health received an improved outlook to stable from negative by Moody's Investors Service, with the affirmation of the A1 rating affecting $4.5 billion in debt (June 2022).

sp.citation_text: S&P dropped the rating to A from A-plus, assigning a stable outlook, in April 2021. This A rating carried into 2023.

fitch.citation_text: In May 2021, Fitch Ratings downgraded Sutter Health to A from A+, with stable outlook. This A rating held entering the window.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Fitch upgraded Sutter Health IDR and revenue bond ratings to A+ from A; stable outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Two straight years of positive operating income; stronger financial performance
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch Rates Sutter Health (CA)'s Series 2023 Bonds 'A+'. Fitch upgraded the Issuer Default Rating (IDR) and ratings on all other outstanding revenue bonds issued by or on behalf of Sutter to 'A+'. The Rating Outlook is Stable.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Fitch revised Sutter Health outlook to positive from stable; A+ rating maintained
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Broad delivery of care network continuing to grow and remain in strong demand across all markets
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Sutter Health's outlook was upgraded to positive from stable by Fitch, with the upgrade reflecting Fitch's expectation that the Sacramento, Calif.-based system's broad delivery of care network will continue to grow.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's A1 stable maintained through window.

sp.citation_text: S&P A stable maintained; no rating action in window.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch A+ with positive outlook per 2024 revision.

outcome_class_rationale: Fitch upgraded Sutter Health from A to A+ in May 2023, and further revised outlook to positive in 2024. Moody's A1 and S&P A held stable. Per schema, UPGRADE = at least one notch upgrade by any agency, no offsetting downgrade.

primary_sources_obtained: Fitch May 2023 Sutter Health new-issue report (KFF mirror PDF)
